messages:
ajay: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a minimal telemetry + fallback sketch for FP8/INT8/4-bit paths so ops/eval can detect quality drift.

katie: Ops wants low-cardinality 100% fields: precision_profile_id (GUID), model@version, degradation_score (aggregate), mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, prompt_fp (hashed).

mike: Add kv_cache_hits and a cheap mismatch proxy: top1_token_mismatch_rate vs a cached shadow.

sophia: Per-layer arrays are expensive. Proposal: sample 1% for per_layer_{mean_abs,max_abs}. All requests include mean_abs_delta and top_k_mismatch_rate plus sample_rate when sampled.

ajay: Where does switching live? Control plane for rollouts, runtime for tiny emergency overrides with hysteresis. Runtime must log overrides with reason_code.

katie: Runtime override rule: only downgrade when (infra_pressure AND quality_safe). Eg (latency>X OR mem>Y) AND degradation_score<Z. Requires two consecutive triggers to avoid flaps.

mike: Canary: start 0.5% traffic, shadow-sample per-layer for canary requests. Auto-rollback if median degradation_score > 0.04 for 5min or top_k_mismatch_rate spike > 0.02. Human approval above 5%. Gate also on tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd.

sophia: I'll open the PR with FSM sketch and schema. Action items: @sophia PR runtime FSM, @ajay publish schema w/examples, @mike draft canary playbook, @katie retention & audit policy.

quant-bot: "RFC follow-up recorded: telemetry schema + hybrid fallback FSM + canary gates." :white_check_mark:
